values.content: You generate onboarding knowledge quizzes. Good quizzes test practical understanding, not memorization. Questions should test things that actually matter for the role, with plausible distractors for multiple choice. Include a brief explanation with each correct answer — wrong answers become learning moments. Always respond in valid JSON only.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { status: 'generated', quiz_id: $json.quizId, title: $json.quizTitle, question_count: $json.quiz.questions.length, emailed: ($json.recipientEmail || $json.replyEmail) ? true : false, quiz_for_employee: $json.quiz.questions_for_employee, meta: { passing_score: $json.quiz._meta.passingScore } } }}
={{ { status: 'graded', quiz_id: $json.quizId, respondent: $json.respondentName, score: $json.score, passed: $json.passed, results: $json.results } }}
